newsitem.title: USA: El Paso Energy sells Tenneco Ventures.
newsitem.headline: El Paso Energy sells Tenneco Ventures.

text.p: El Paso Energy Corp said Thursday it sold its oil and gas exploration, production and financing unit, formerly known as Tenneco Ventures, to the unit's management team and First Reserve Corp in a $105 million transaction.
El Paso acquired the Ventures business last month as part of its $4 billion acquisition of Tenneco Energy when Tenneco Inc restructured its ownership in various units.

The newly independent company, Domain Energy Corp, is owned by management along with its equity partner, First Reserve, an energy investment management firm with offices in Houston and Greenwich, Conn.

"These proceeds, along with $400 million generated through the project financing and sale of equity interests in our Australian operations, significantly reduce our debt load and help realign our balance sheet," El Paso said.
The company assumed $2.8 billion of Tenneco debt and preferred stock in the December 12 acquisition of Tenneco Energy and issued about $900 million of new common equity.

Domain Energy's core oil and gas properties are primarily located in the Gulf of Mexico region and West Texas. The company also provides financing to independent producers and operates and invests in oil and gas properties on behalf of institutional investors.
As of July 1, 1996, it had proved reserves of 159 billion cubic feet equivalent.
